final: WITH team_games AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), total_games AS (SELECT SUM(games) AS games FROM team_games), shares AS (SELECT t.team_id, t.games, t.games * 1.0 / a.games AS share FROM team_games AS t JOIN total_games AS a ON a.games IS NOT NULL), average_games AS (SELECT AVG(games) AS games FROM shares) SELECT s.team_id, s.games, s.share, s.games * 1.0 / a.games FROM shares AS s JOIN average_games AS a ON a.games IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.games * 1.0 / a.games DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
